items.text: Lamar Jackson listed QUESTIONABLE (ankle) for Sunday vs Bengals; status crucial for DFS slate.
items.why: ETR Sunday injury dump; limited practice all week, trending return but Q official.
items.implication: If OUT, Huntley starts; Ravens offense downgrade, Zay Flowers/Henry impacted.
items.opportunity: Monitor pregame; full workload if ACTIVE.

items.text: Puka Nacua QUESTIONABLE (calf); will test pregame after limited/majority Thursday practice, no Friday. McVay: lacked power/explosion.
items.why: Calf felt during practice; true game-time decision.
items.implication: If OUT, Stafford hierarchy shifts heavily to TEs; if IN, still WR1.
items.opportunity: TE target share spike historically 37% when Puka out.

items.text: Breece Hall QUESTIONABLE (quad) for Sunday vs Dolphins; game-time lean possible miss or committee.
items.implication: If OUT, Braelon Allen RB1 upside in great matchup; if IN, start but monitor snaps.

items.text: Mike Evans ruled OUT (Achilles/ribs) for 49ers vs Falcons; coach Shanahan confirmed.
items.implication: 49ers WR corps depleted; volume to CMC/Kittle.

items.text: Deebo Samuel ruled OUT (hamstring) alongside Evans for 49ers at Falcons.
items.implication: Further concentrates targets on Kittle/CMC; dire WR situation.
items.opportunity: CMC slot temptation confirmed by player comments.

items.text: Josh Jacobs listed IN; cleared for facility meetings/lifting/medical (non-football activities previously allowed).
items.why: ETR IN list; Levitan notes backups Lloyd/Johnson poor EPA/rush.
items.implication: Returns to lead role but rust/workload questions post-layoff; Berry hates for Week 7.
items.opportunity: Full backfield if no limitations; OL mess caps upside.
items.conflict: Berry HATE vs Levitan long-term positive notes

items.text: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) ruled OUT for Falcons vs 49ers.
items.why: Official; listed in Schefter/ETR OUT dumps.
items.implication: Bijan Robinson full backfield + receiving work vs soft SF DvP.
items.opportunity: SF conceding RB catches (White/Holani/Harvey/Love recent); DvP +4.4% RB inflation.

items.text: David Montgomery ruled OUT; listed among Sunday scratches.
items.implication: Jahmyr Gibbs full snaps/goal-line in Detroit.

items.text: Rashee Rice ruled OUT (pictured in Schefter dump) for Chiefs.
Colston Loveland BACK/LOVE with Caleb Williams: 30% target share, 19.2 PPR/game, 6+ rec and 60+ yards in both games since return. Kmet IR adds juice.
items.why: Elite usage post-Caleb return + Kmet season-ending.

items.text: Bijan Robinson full + sweet setup vs 49ers (BRob OUT); SF DvP inflates opposing RB by 4.4% (7th-most), recent RB catches galore (White 4-30-1, Harvey 10-68, etc).
items.why: BRob OUT + SF soft vs RBs receiving/run.

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts (scheme + entire 49ers WR corps hurt: Evans/Deebo OUT); rarely buy RB-as-WR but tempted on CMC slot comments given Kaelon Black/WRs out. Kittle not National TE Day myth.
items.why: Dire WR injuries + CMC smile on slot question.
items.implication: Kittle TE1 smash; CMC receiving spike possible.
items.opportunity: Target funnel to TE/RB; CMC routes in slot.

items.text: Bears TE Cole Kmet to IR with season-ending serious knee injury (carted Thursday); Coach Johnson confirmed.
items.implication: Reduces 2/3-TE sets; more WR routes/juice for Burden and Loveland already surging.
items.opportunity: Burden YPRR elite 2.56 on 68.8% routes; more snaps likely.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson played just 21% snaps over last three weeks; clear downgrade in role.
